current_date: In force for West Lindsey from 1 July 2024 (council page)
current_evidence: The West Lindsey page 'Local validation list 1 July 2024' says the lists took effect for West Lindsey on 1 July 2024. The Central Lincolnshire review page says the May-June 2026 consultation on revised 2026 lists closed on 7 June 2026 with no adoption yet, and 'the current adopted Local Validation Lists remain in force'.

issues.detail: The list date 2024-05-01 comes from the URL upload folder. For West Lindsey the lists took effect on 1 July 2024, after a delay from the planned 20 May 2024. The PDF itself carries no date.
issues.evidence: WL page: 'implementation of the local validation requirements for West Lindsey District Council was delayed until 1 July 2024'

issues.detail: Pending change: Central Lincolnshire consulted from about 11 May to 7 June 2026 on revised 2026 Full, Outline, Householder and Listed Building lists. These are not yet adopted, so the workbook should flag the 2024 lists for imminent replacement.
issues.evidence: central-lincs.org.uk: 'the current adopted Local Validation Lists remain in force' until revised lists are formally adopted

issues.detail: Grokbot recorded only about 7 requirements for Full planning (BNG, CIL, D&AS, EIA, Heritage, Highways, Structural Survey). The Full Applications list has a full Category 2 'Local Validation Requirements' table that Grokbot missed almost entirely. It includes Tree Survey & Arboricultural Method Statement (CLLP S66), Energy Statement and Energy Efficiency Checklist (S6-S8), Ecological Impact Assessment (S60), Biodiversity Gain Statement and BNG Metric and post-development habitat map (S61, unless exempt), Drainage Statement (S21), Agricultural Land Classification survey (S14/S67), Green Wedge Assessment (S63), Minerals Assessment (LCCMWLP M11), Transport Statement/Assessment (S47/S49), Travel Plan (S29/S47/S49), Aviation/Defence Navigation assessment (S14), Shadow Flicker (S14), Glint and Glare (S14/S53), Agricultural Workers Dwelling justification (S5), Affordable Housing/First Homes/Entry-level exception site needs assessment (S4/S22), Custom and Self-build plot passports/design code (NS24), Health Impact Assessment (S54), Town Centre/Retail Impact/Sequential Assessment (S29-S35), Marketing Report for loss of business/tourism uses (S5a, S40, S43...), Alternative Employment Sites Assessment (S28-S34), Agricultural/rural needs assessment (S5), Demolition Justification Statement (S11) and Open Space Assessment (S51).
issues.evidence: Full Applications Validation List, 'Category 2: Local Validation Requirements (Development Plan policies)'

issues.detail: Category 3 'Other requirements' that Grokbot also missed for Full planning are: Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zone 2/3 including minor development and change of use; over 1 ha in Zone 1; Zone 1 critical drainage areas) with sequential/exception test evidence, Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment (S62), Groundwater Risk Assessment (S21/S56), Noise Assessment (S14/S53), Dust Assessment, Odour/Air Quality Assessment (S69), External Lighting Assessment (NS55/S53), Unexploded Ordnance/Land Quality (S84), Contaminated Land Assessment (S56/S83), and S106 Heads of Terms (S22/S45). The same gap almost certainly applies to Outline, which Grokbot also gave only 6 rows.
issues.evidence: Full Applications Validation List, 'Category 3: Other Requirements'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' tab item and the BNG triggers start with fee text ('Correct Planning Fee See current fees at: pdf Biodiversity Net Gain mandatory requirements...'). The fee is a national requirement and the text runs two table rows together. The BNG trigger excerpts under Householder, Full and Outline all start with this fee/URL fragment.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: 'Correct Planning Fee See current fees at: s.pdf Biodiversity Net Gain mandatory requirements Where an applicant believes...'

issues.detail: Biodiversity Net Gain is listed under Householder, but householder development is exempt from statutory BNG. Highways/visibility splays is listed under Listed building consent, and its trigger is only part of a block-plan description ('public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking...'), not a highways requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Householder BNG row; LBC row 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)'

issues.detail: Many triggers mix column text from the matrix PDFs. For example, D&AS (Householder) reads 'Forms part of the planning application form Design and Access Statement Site Location Plan2 1 1 Required for...'. Block plan reads '...Existing and Proposed Elevations2 1:50 or 1:100 scale Existing and Proposed Floor Plan 2...'. Heritage starts mid-row with footnote numerals ('Heritage Statement3', 'Heritage Statement5'). Structural Survey reads only 'combined with Structural Survey.', which is really the Demolition Justification Statement row. Archaeology repeats the Heritage Statement text, while the list has a separate Archaeological Assessment row (CLLP S57).
issues.evidence: Grokbot app_type_rows trigger_excerpt; Full list rows 'Demolition Justification Statement - CLLP S11; may be combined with a Structural Survey'

issues.detail: The document is hosted on North Kesteven's site as a joint Central Lincolnshire list. That is valid, since it is the joint partnership list, but West Lindsey's own page does not link the per-type PDFs, only the consultation summary report. The workbook should cite the WL page as the effective-date evidence.
issues.evidence: WL page links only 'Local Validation Checklist and Summary of Consultation Responses report'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current joint Central Lincolnshire Full Applications list, in force for West Lindsey from 1 July 2024, with 2026 revisions consulted on but not yet adopted. The extract is badly incomplete: it misses nearly all of the roughly 25 Category 2 policy-driven local requirements and most Category 3 items, and its triggers are garbled matrix text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
